description: Track every document added or changed in one RIS application within an exact date window (changed_from/changed_to), optionally including deletions (include_deleted) — the delta-sync and monitoring primitive for mirrors and watchers, and the only surface that reports removals. Unlike the search tools’ coarse, additive-only changed_since intervals, this is exact-dated and deletion-aware. application accepts every RIS application code listed by ris_list_reference topic applications, including BrKons, LrKons, Dsk, and BgblAuth. Each changed document comes back in a compact cross-class record — document_number (for ris_get_document), title, dates, binding_status, and rendition URLs — plus its last-changed date; removed documents come back as deleted records with a deletion timestamp. One application per call; page explicitly for large windows.

application.description: RIS application whose change feed to read, e.g. BrKons, LrKons, Dsk, or BgblAuth. All supported codes: ris_list_reference topic applications.

changed_from.description: Include documents changed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, AenderungenVon). Exact date, not a coarse interval.

changed_to.description: Include documents changed on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, AenderungenBis).

include_deleted.description: true also returns documents removed from RIS in the window, as deleted records — the only way to observe deletions.

page_size.description: Documents per page: 10 or 20 (default 20). For more results, keep the size and raise page.

name: ris_track_changes

application.description: The application whose change feed was read.

changedFrom.description: The changed_from bound the server applied (echo), when set.

changedTo.description: The changed_to bound the server applied (echo), when set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: RIS rejected a parameter value in-band — its Client error message is passed through verbatim and names the offending element (e.g. a page past the last page of the change window). `upstream_error`: RIS is unreachable, returned a server error, or served an HTML error page. `upstream_timeout`: RIS did not answer the change feed within the request deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Zero-hit guidance — names the likely cause and the concrete next call.

results.description: Change-feed entries for the requested page. Totals, paging, and the applied window in enrichment.

items.description: One change-feed entry — a changed document, or a deletion record.

authentic_pdf_url.description: The amtssigniert authentic PDF (.pdfsig, Authentisch DataType), where the changed document publishes one.

binding_status.description: Legal binding status of the queried application — authentic (amtssigniert, legally binding), consolidated_informational, historical_record, decision, preparatory, administrative_directive, or translation.

changed.description: Date this document last changed in RIS (Allgemein.Geaendert).

content_urls.description: Rendition URLs of the changed document. Empty for a deletion record.

deleted.description: True when this record marks a document removed from RIS (include_deleted only).

deleted_at.description: Deletion import timestamp (ImportTimestamp) — deletion records only.

document_number.description: Technical RIS document number (Technisch.ID) — pass with application to ris_get_document.

document_url.description: RIS web view of the document (Allgemein.DokumentUrl) — for humans.

organ.description: Issuing body (Organ) of the document, where the record carries one.

published.description: Date this document was first published in RIS (Allgemein.Veroeffentlicht).

title.description: Document title, HTML markup stripped, where present.

totalCount.description: Total change-feed entries across all pages.

truncated.description: Present and true when more pages exist beyond this one — raise page to continue.

title: Track RIS Changes
